correction: The initial MyGo InstalledApps launcher assumed menu-visible entries were the same as launchable desktop IDs and that a running MyGo app was always available. InstalledApps filters NoDisplay entries and requires App.Run. The launcher now resolves IDs through GIO without either restriction.
evidence: frostyard/frostui#21 review by bketelsen (2026-11-12); MyGo v0.9.0 internal/linux/apps.go Applications and app.go needsApp; TestLaunchDesktopApp launches a NoDisplay entry before App.Run
